blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Securities and Exchange Commission in the Philippines will allow qualified first-time initial public offering (IPO) applicants to avoid monetary penalties for unintentional financial reporting errors and disclosure deficiencies, provided they fully correct the findings before the regulator approves their registration.
